name: stripe-webhook-next
title: Stripe webhook routes (Next.js)
description: A Stripe webhook route that stores verified events, and a cron route that hands them to the billing block.
docs: Needs the billing block and the webhook inbox: `npx better-supabase add billing webhook-inbox`. Point a Stripe test-mode webhook (or `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/stripe`) at the first route, and schedule `/api/stripe/process`. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/billing.
